Ben (Acme): Getting a 413 on /v1/rerank since we switched to sending full article text. Error body: {"error": "payload too large", "code": 413}. We send ~420 docs, avg ~5k chars each, query ~350 chars — used to work with snippets. Anyone seen this?

Alice (Support): Sorry you're blocked. Can you paste the exact curl (redact keys) and one redacted sample doc so we can estimate tokens? Also: is the text HTML or plain?

Ben (Acme): Redacted curl:
````
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"query":"How do refunds work?","documents":[{"id":"a1","text":"<big doc>"},...,{"id":"a420","text":"<big doc>"}]}'
````
Docs are plain text (scraped), some have code blocks. I'll DM one example.

support-bot: Created ticket SUP-1498 and linked.

Carlos (Eng): Quick context: rerank enforces a combined input ceiling (query + all docs). Exceed it and edge rejects with 413. The current message is generic; we should make it actionable.

Carlos (Eng): If you can run a token count locally that helps. Example (python / tiktoken):
````
from tiktoken import encoding_for_model
enc = encoding_for_model(\"redwood-rerank-1\")
count = len(enc.encode(text_blob))
print(count)
````
If not available: rough rule of thumb 4 characters ~= 1 token.

Ben (Acme): Using that rule a single doc ~1250 tokens -> 420 docs ~= 525k tokens. Yikes.

Dana (CS): That will blow the combined limit. Short-term options:
- Send fewer docs per request (try <= 75 for large docs)
- Extract 1-3 passages per document (~200-800 tokens each) and pass those instead of full text
- Pre-filter with embeddings or a cheap semantic search to narrow to candidates
- If you must rerank many docs, batch the rerank calls and merge scores client-side

Alice (Support): For triage: please share the exact request timestamp and any request-id in your client logs so we can correlate with edge logs. Also is this happening consistently?

Ben (Acme): Happening consistently after switching to full text. Timestamp: 2817654337, client-request-id: cli_ef12

Ellen (SRE): Pulling logs now for cli_ef12. Preliminary: edge proxy rejected request due to configured max_input_bytes. No model node was invoked.

Carlos (Eng): Confirmed. The reject happens at the edge layer before the runtime. UX ask: return a dedicated error code like INPUT_TOO_LARGE and include estimated tokens/bytes and the configured limit. Eg: \"413 INPUT_TOO_LARGE: combined input 5.2M bytes > limit 5.0M. Try reducing docs or passing snippets.\"

Dana (CS): Short mitigation snippets we can share with customers:
- Passage extraction example: keep top 3 passages per doc (~300 tokens each)
- Batch pattern: break doc list into N-sized chunks (N=50-75 depending on doc size) and call rerank for each chunk, then combine scores
- Example merge heuristic: take max passage score per document or weighted average across passages depending on your scoring semantics

Carlos (Eng): Example merging pattern (psuedo):
````
all_scores = defaultdict(list)
for batch in batches:
  res = rerank(batch)  # returns [{id, score}]
  for r in res:
    all_scores[r['id']].append(r['score'])
# final score options:
final_scores = {did: max(scores) for did,scores in all_scores.items()}
# or use mean: {did: sum(scores)/len(scores)}
````
Choose max if passages are independent signals, mean if you want consensus.

Alice (Support): Note: splitting requests increases token usage billing-wise. We'll add a note to the KB and include cost examples.

Ellen (SRE): Current edge combined payload limit for this cluster is 5MB. We can consider making it configurable per-customer on Dedicated, but hosted tier will keep a global guard.

Carlos (Eng): I'll file a small backlog item to change the 413 payload to: code=INPUT_TOO_LARGE, details={"bytes": X, "limit_bytes": Y, "tokens_estimate": Z}, plus suggestions (limit docs to 75, pass snippets).

Alice (Support): Action items:
- Support: send KB with passage extraction + batching examples to customer (done in DM)
- Eng: add improved 413 payload + error code (Carlos)
- SRE: confirm 5MB limit and feasibility of per-customer knob (Ellen)

Ben (Acme): Implemented batching to 60 docs + passage extraction (top 2 passages per doc). No more 413s and ranks look correct. Thanks for the fast help! :tada:

Carlos (Eng): Great. We'll follow up in the ticket once we have a PR for the enhanced error payload and a KB update.

Alice (Support): Closing note: if you want us to review your passage extraction for quality tradeoffs send a sample set and we'll run a quick eval.

Ben (Acme): Will do. Appreciate it.
